versions.notes: the green arrows follow a switch at once (also in Simple), taken from the switches on the page itself.
AI model download from Google's storage address (the old address has no valid certificate); shorter error messages.
«download failed» message in all languages.
AI model with one tap: «Download AI model» (self-check, AI settings, Pi window) fetches the two model files (about 70 MB) into the data folder and switches the AI on - no commands needed any more.
one-page quick guide for the campsite (5 languages, printable): set up, connect, evening, alarm, morning, when something does not work. The QR card is now called «QR codes for connecting».

false alarms: mark a recording «was nothing» (animal, wind, light, rain, car, other); the recordings page then suggests matching settings (one tap to take them over) and can show only the false alarms.

settings «Simple / Expert» (simple: only the important ones, on the web and in the Pi window); button «Guard tonight»: switches on what a night needs, arms with the countdown and tells what is still missing.

self-check: one traffic light per part (camera, AI, servos, thermal camera, microphone, loudspeaker, temperature sensor, location, clock, internet, push, memory card, CPU temperature, power supply, battery, password, https) with what to do; on the web (panel + header badge) and in the Pi window (Weather & system).
privacy: shared pictures and videos no longer carry the location (switch «Send the location along when sharing», off by default). Downloads and the ZIP keep it - they are for yourself.
settings: the location is either taken automatically from the phone or picked by tapping on a map (with place search and «my position»); replaces the two number fields.
the marmot only appears over the live picture (never in recordings) and keeps its secret better.

recordings: filter by place (pictures within 2 km = one place, names from OpenStreetMap, can be renamed) and a map with all places (tap = preview, «show only this place»). The Bluetooth loudspeaker is no longer on the page «Cameras» (still under Settings -> Loudspeaker). The marmot only peeks out briefly; the code on its belly is real.
the marmot has a little secret on its belly.

diary: day overview for every day - persons, animals (best pictures), warm bodies, noises, recordings; 24-hour chart with temperature / humidity of the sensor, weather (Open-Meteo, off by default), rain and the events; sun, moon, place and the night report. Browse the days with ‹ › or the date.

temperature sensor: BME280 / BMP280 (temperature, humidity, air pressure, I2C 0x76/0x77) or DS18B20 (1-Wire GPIO 4) are found by themselves; shown in the header and under Setup; every 10 minutes a value is kept for the diary.

GPS: the phone sends its location (https page), otherwise the place from the settings; photos, snapshots, timelapse and diary pictures get EXIF GPS data, videos a location tag (shown on the map in photo apps); the phone location also keeps sunrise / sunset right.

night vision look: green image-intensifier picture with grain and dark corners, the thermal camera draws glowing outlines of warm bodies and (Thermal-90) their temperature; quick switch 🌙 and «automatically at night».

five languages: German, French, Italian, Romansh (Rumantsch Grischun) and English - web page, window, manual, setup assistant, push / SMS texts, quick start card, guest page; language menu instead of DE/EN (Ctrl+L in the window: next language); missing Romansh texts fall back to German. Two small surprises for Swiss users.

always a live picture: phone and tablet upright show a small live picture in a corner as soon as the big one is scrolled away (the same picture moves, no second stream); tap = back up, drag = other corner, ✕ = away; red frame while a person is seen. Tablet landscape / computer: the picture column stays anyway (only the settings scroll).

⇆ next to the speed swaps the stick and the small buttons (left- / right-handed); on the phone in landscape the control column goes to the other side of the picture, in fullscreen the stick too (one choice per device; window: kept).
